name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.174: A Jellyfin restart is no longer reported as a user stop. Both cancel the running
    task identically and the token carries no reason, so the catch treated them the same - it
    wrote a stop marker and called RequestUserStop, which records cancelled/"user stop" for BOTH
    directions at once. Measured on prod: a restart at 14:18 painted the download as a user stop
    although its run had finished clean at 14:08, and the upload as stopped by a button nobody
    pressed; 58 uploads that had reached SubDL sat behind an action the user never took. The stop
    marker is the discriminator - the Stop endpoint writes it before it signals, a shutdown never
    does - so it is now tested without being consumed and everything else records ok/"restart".
    Postprocessing and the OSHash refresh have no stop button, so for them every cancellation is a
    restart by construction.
